from.place: proof steps 1 and 2: the affine-local computation of Lf^* and of the derived tensor product (08DW(2), 08DX(2)) and their compatibility with restriction to opens

title: Affine computation of derived pullback and derived tensor product
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived pullback $Lf^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback] and derived categories as in [def-pc-derived-category]; for a scheme $Z$ write $K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_Z}L$ for the derived tensor product, the total tensor complex [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] of a K-flat resolution of $K$ [def-pc-kflat-complex] with $L$. (1) For opens $U\subseteq X$, $V\subseteq Y$ with $f(U)\subseteq V$ and $E$ in $D(\mathcal O_Y)$ there is a canonical isomorphism $(Lf^*E)|_U\cong L(f|_U)^*(E|_V)$ in $D(\mathcal O_U)$, and for $K,L$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$ a canonical isomorphism $(K\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}L)|_U\cong K|_U\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_U}L|_U$. (2) If $X=\operatorname{Spec}(B)$, $Y=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ and $f$ is given by a ring map $A\to B$, then for every complex $M^\bullet$ of $A$-modules $Lf^*\widetilde{M^\bullet}\cong\widetilde{M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}B}$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$, where $\widetilde{(-)}$ is the termwise associated sheaf and $\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}$ the derived tensor product of complexes of modules. (3) If $X=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$, then for complexes $M^\bullet,N^\bullet$ of $A$-modules $\widetilde{M^\bullet}\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{\mathcal O_X}\widetilde{N^\bullet}\cong\widetilde{M^\bullet\otimes_A^{\mathbf L}N^\bullet}$ in $D(\mathcal O_X)$.
